scenes.description: An old window rattling in gusty wind, its loose frame visibly vibrating with several short motion marks along the edges. A slightly uneven pane and simple interior, no broken glass.
A person gently tests an old wooden desk; motion marks and a close-up inset show a loose, wobbling joint.
Beside folded laundry, one person gestures with a dissatisfied expression while another listens with a hand at their neck.
